name: Coding Task Rubric
description: Rubric specifically for evaluating coding and technical prompts.

criteria.name: technical_accuracy
criteria.description: Does the prompt use correct technical terminology?

criteria.name: specificity
criteria.description: Are language, framework, and constraints clearly specified?

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: Are edge cases, error handling, and requirements covered?

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Is the expected output format clear?
